statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness
The symptoms are suspected to be related to underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Cardiac event monitoring was ordered for ambulatory assessment
The monitoring was ordered to evaluate potential arrhythmias or conduction abnormalities contributing to these symptoms
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
Payment for this service is not reimbursable as a standalone item when performed in conjunction with the primary diagnostic evaluation
